redaction_rules.R1: system/user ATIF step message text removed; sha256 and length kept
redaction_rules.R2: agent/sessions/**, agent/opencode.txt and agent/opencode/** raw model I/O and runtime state (SQLite/WAL/log/snapshot/auth) omitted; sha256 recorded; symlinks digest-recorded by link-target string and never dereferenced; non-R2 symlinks fail closed
redaction_rules.R3a: verifier/* JSON string values over 1024 bytes replaced by digest markers
redaction_rules.R3b: verifier/* text files over 4096 bytes promoted as a whole-file digest marker with no body
redaction_rules.R4: each omitted rollout leaves a quota sidecar under <trial>/agent/quota/ holding only the event timestamp and a whitelist of payload.rate_limits scalars, with the parent rollout's sha256; account-scope point-in-time readings, no message, prompt, reasoning, session title or token
